dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It sounds like you want to join the Fatui...

dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: I wouldn't go that far. I hear their casualty rate is through the roof, and I'm not all that keen to risk my neck. I just think everything here's pretty interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: After all, does anyone really want to be a sailor for the rest of their lives? Then again, being a sailor has its perks — you never know what sort of interesting people or things you're gonna find at your next port of call.
